guide.title: Smuggler's Boat

source.author: A_Backdated_Future

objectives: Collect the **Rosewood Bracelet** and **Witch's Broth** below deck
Win something from each Lottery Member, including the **Iron Clogs**

obtainable.name: Rosewood Bracelet
obtainable.location: Chest on the left side of the room, below deck (step 1)

obtainable.name: Witch's Broth
obtainable.location: Top barrel to the upper-right, after the scene with Margarete (step 1)

obtainable.name: Lottery Ticket
obtainable.location: Floor near the wheel and the hanging blanket in the wheelhouse (step 2)

bosses.name: Li Li
bosses.strategy:
- **Dark Messenger** is not used this time, but **Paralysis** still does decent damage, so guard against the Paralysis effect with your **Rosewood Bracelets**.
- Watch out for **Hate Storm**, which does decent damage to your whole party.
- Start off by healing, if needed.
- **With Heaven's Fiend:** have Yuri use **Heaven's Fiend** and the **Exorcist Arrow** attack (MAJOR damage).
- **With Heaven's Fiend:** Alice casts **Holy Edge** on Margaret, then **Blessed Light**.
- **With Heaven's Fiend:** Margaret attacks normally and uses **Thera** and **Mana Leaves** when HP/MP are low.
- **With Heaven's Fiend:** if you need a second healer, **Heaven's Fiend**'s **Sacred Remedy** heals EVERYONE, especially after **Hate Storm**.
- **Without Heaven's Fiend:** have Yuri fuse into **Inferno** or **Raging Tiger** (your two physically strongest Fusions at this point) and use normal attacks.
- **Without Heaven's Fiend:** with **Inferno**, use **Fighting Spirit** first to increase his attack.
- **Without Heaven's Fiend:** Alice casts **Holy Edge** on Yuri, then **Blessed Light** REPEATEDLY.
- **Without Heaven's Fiend:** Margaret is the primary healer, using **Thera** and **Mana Leaves** when HP/MP are low.

steps.description:
1. When you gain control of a very queasy Yuri, open the chest on the left side of the room for a **Rosewood Bracelet**.
2. Go up the stairs to the right for some dialogue with Margarete, then go down and left, examining the door to the wheelhouse for a scene.
3. Afterward, head left a bit more, then check the top barrel to the upper-right for a **Witch's Broth**.
4. Move left and talk to Zhuzhen, then make your way back below deck to talk with Alice for a long scene.

1. You'll regain control under the deck as just Yuri. Save your game, then go back out on deck.
2. Head inside the wheelhouse and take out the group of monsters here.
3. Before leaving, check the floor near the wheel and the blanket hanging for a **Lottery Ticket**.
4. Go back outside and downstairs to take out a second group of enemies.
5. Once they're finished, go back out on the deck and talk to Zhuzhen to fight one last group.

notes.title: Level up for the fusions
notes.text: It should be fairly easy to obtain both your level 1 Fire and Water Fusions here, since the enemies come in groups of 3 and 4. I strongly recommend doing so, as it won't take long at all. Also, make sure Alice is at least level 11 so that she learns the Blessed Light spell.

steps.description:
1. Once they're done, and Zhuzhen is finished with the preparations, make your way back down to below the deck and save your game.
2. Before continuing, stop in the wheelhouse once more and talk to the **Courier Subordinate**, who's asking if you need anything in a strange way.

choices.outcome: Allows you to see what items he has for sale.
Allows you to discover that he's actually a **Lottery Member**.

steps.description: Choosing option 1 lets you see the items he has for sale (see the shop table below).

notes.title: Bring three Rosewood Bracelets
notes.text: Make sure that you have **THREE Rosewood Bracelets** to put on your active party, as the next boss can paralyze you. Also make sure to have enough healing items.

notes.title: Shop source is unclear
notes.text: The source lists this inventory under **Pachimon General Store**, but does not say which vendor sells these items. The Courier Subordinate is the only seller mentioned in this section.

steps.description: Choosing option 2 reveals that he's actually a **Lottery Member**!

1. Equipping the **Pocket Watch** makes it easier to hit the areas, since the ring here moves fast.
2. Win the **Iron Clogs** before continuing on.
3. If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
4. Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once.

notes.title: Win the Iron Clogs
notes.text: The Iron Clogs slow down the indicator speed on your Judgment Ring, but they also lower your Agl by 15 points. Make sure to win them before continuing on.

notes.title: Lottery prizes by color
notes.text: Each color is a prize from this Lottery Member.

steps.description: When you're prepared for the next boss, go back and talk to Zhuzhen. He'll ask if you're ready.

choices.outcome: After an event, you'll be thrown into a battle.

steps.description: Fight the **Li Li** sub-boss, a warm-up battle. Try to avoid using TOO much MP for the next boss battle.

notes.title: Dark Messenger can instantly kill
notes.text: She can and will use **Dark Messenger**, which can instantly kill a party member.

boss.name: Li Li
boss.strategy:
- She can and will use **Dark Messenger**, which not only deals major damage, but can instantly kill a party member, so be careful.
- Her other attacks are **Paralysis** (which does decent damage, but you should be guarded against the actual Paralysis effect with your **Rosewood Bracelets**) and a normal attack, which you shouldn't need to worry about.
- If you have it, have Yuri use **Heaven's Fiend** and use the **Exorcist Arrow** attack; it should do MAJOR damage.
- Alice should cast **Holy Edge** on Margarete first, so she has Light-based attacks, then she should cast **Blessed Light**.
- Margaret should just be attacking normally, using **Thera** and **Mana Leaves** whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low.
- If you really need a second healer, **Heaven's Fiend** is perfect for the role, as its **Sacred Remedy** will heal EVERYONE in the party.
- If you don't have **Heaven's Fiend**, have Yuri fuse into either **Inferno** or **Raging Tiger** (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this point) and use normal attacks on her.
- If he has **Inferno**, use the **Fighting Spirit** skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on her.
- Alice should cast **Holy Edge** on Yuri first, so he has Light-based attacks, then she should cast **Blessed Light**.
- Margaret should just be attacking normally, using **Thera** and **Mana Leaves** whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low.
- Not much to worry about (other than **Dark Messenger**) here.

steps.description: Watch a bit of dialogue, then you'll take on a powered-up form of **Li Li** (720 HP).

steps.description: Watch the sad series of events, then you'll regain control on the World Map. Next stop: **Shanghai!**

notes.title: Remove accessories before Shanghai
notes.text: Make sure to remove your accessories from your party before entering, as you'll be controlling Zhuzhen for a short time.
